title: Aimed Shots
section:
Hit roll bonus of 1 if not moving; 2 if firing one shot.
Cannot aim: with Heavy weapons (except Sniper weapons), Blast or Engulf weapons, or Grenades; if panicking; if the model has any Flame tokens.

title: Ambush
section:
Set up wholly within any area terrain, more than 1″ from enemies, and more than 9″ from enemies within the same area terrain.
No more than one model or unit can be set up in the same area terrain feature in the same phase.

title: Apparitions (Summoning)
section: 2✷ in first round, 1✷ in second round; free otherwise. Set up wholly within 12″ of Psyker and more than 9″ from enemies.

title: Assault
section: Can advance and attack; hit roll penalty of 1.

title: Barricades
section: Treated as being within 1″ while within 2″. Can use cover save to defend against melee attacks.

title: Battle Standard
section: Visible friendlies within 9″ re-roll failed morale checks, and improve Ld by 1 if this model's Ld is greater. +1 to control score if this model is within 3″ of objective, even if they are non-scoring.

title: Beam
section: Make a hit roll for each model under a 1 mm line, up to the maximum range. Stray shots cannot be allocated to models or units under the line.

title: Blast
section:
Target models must be within 2″ of initial target. Targets must be within maximum range but only initial target needs to be visible; targets not visible are obscured and improve cover by 1.
Hit rolls per model equals A value, multiplied by X if target is Large (X). Stray shots can only be allocated to models within 2″.

title: Broken Warband
section: Warbands with less than half their starting models (including models in reserve) are broken: faltering models continue to falter, and if they fail further morale checks they automatically panic until the next Resolution Phase.

title: Camouflage (X)
section: Stealth (see below), but only if this model would be able to make a cover save against the attack.

title: Charging
section: Can charge and attack; hit roll penalty of 1.

title: Composed
section: A composed model is not faltering or panicking.

title: Controlling an Objective
section:
• +1 control score for each model within 3″
  • +Ld difference for model with the best Ld
  • Models within 1″ of enemies are non-scoring
  • Control lasts until next Secure Objectives step

title: Cover Saves
section:
• 7+: Trees and sturdy vegetation
  • 6+: Wooden barricades, stacks of boxes; tank traps; loose rubble, craters
  • 5+: Buildings, ruins and fortifications; concrete or metal barricades; trench walls

title: Dangerous Terrain
section:
After moving, 1 injury on a roll of 1 (roll of 1 or 2 if advancing, charging, retreating, jumping or falling).
Extremely Dangerous Terrain: D3 injuries on a roll of 1 or 2 (automatically if advancing, charging, retreating, jumping or falling).
Burning Terrain: Flame token on a roll of 1 or 2.

title: Deep Strike (X+)
section:
Set up anywhere, including within 1″ of enemies - this is not a charge. Mv reduced to 0″ but treated as having moved.

  • Displaced (roll less than X): opponent moves models up to 9″ horizontally and 3″ vertically.
  • Mishap (roll of 1, or any failed roll if within 1″ of enemies): D4-1 injuries for each model.

title: Defensive Fire
section: Hit roll penalty of 1. Can only target the charging models; treated as within 0″ and visible.

title: Difficult Terrain
section: Subtract 2″ from maximum distance. Bikers and Cavalry treat difficult terrain as dangerous.

title: Engulf
section: Choose targets and make hits like Blast; also target models obscuring any target. Hits are automatically successful and ignore cover saves.

title: Ephemeral
section: Non-scoring, ignores serious injuries. Lose D2 life at the beginning of each round; if a unit, D4 life, distributed among the unit. Psykers within 12″ can reduce life lost by 1 for each 1✷ spent.

title: Ethereal
section: Armour is invulnerable, unless attacked by Ethereal, Daemon, Psyker, Apparition, Warpflame or Warpstone. Not affected by difficult terrain, cannot be injured by falling.

title: Explodes!
section: D8+Dm of last hit: if 9+, explode. D2 injuries within 3″, 1 injury within 6″. Each model within 6″: on a 2+, get a Flame token, 2 tokens on an 8.

title: Falling
section:
• 3″+: 1 injury on a roll less than armour save, otherwise D3 injuries
  • 6″+: D3 injuries on a roll less than armour save, otherwise immediately destroyed
  • 9″+: immediately destroyed

title: Faltering
section: Re-roll hit rolls of 8, non-scoring, cannot be involved in a Moment of Glory.

title: Familiar (X+)
section:
Can attack with this weapon in addition to any other weapons; BS/CS is X+.
For ranged attacks:

  • Can advance and attack
  • Can target models that are not visible
  • Ignores cover saves
  • Cannot attack at long range
  • Not affected by aiming

Sacrifice to discard a hit (before saving throws).

title: Fearsome
section: Must make a morale check if within 3″ and visible.

title: Flame
section: Hit roll penalty of 1, cannot aim. In Take Damage step, one AP 0 hit for each Flame token, to a maximum of 3; then discard tokens. Must make a morale check if they had Flame tokens in the round.

title: Flying
section: Ignores vertical distance, cannot be injured by falling, can move across other models. Only affected by difficult or dangerous terrain if they start or end their move within the terrain.

title: Game Length
section: 5 rounds, then 6th round on 5+.

title: Generating Warp Charges
section: Three D8s; one charge on 3+, two on 8. Perils on two or more 8s. Overcharging rolls one extra dice.

title: Heal (X+)
section: X+: model within 3″ regains 1 life, or discards all Poison and Plague tokens. Use in the Recovery step, or when a model is about to be destroyed.

title: Heavy (X)
section: Hit roll penalty of 1 if moving; 2 if moving half Mv or more. Cannot move and attack with Heavy (2+).

title: Hidden Traps
section: Note three locations during deployment: area terrain up to 8″ diameter, other terrain or objective (3″ radius), deployment zone edge up to 12″ length. A trap is triggered when an enemy model or unit moves within range; resolve effects after they have completed their movement.

title: Hover
section: Ignores downwards vertical distance, cannot be injured by falling, can move across other models. Not affected by difficult or dangerous terrain, except burning terrain

title: Ignore Damage (X+)
section: Ignore each injury on a roll of X+.

title: Indirect
section: Target models not visible, and treat targets as not being obscured; hit roll penalty of 1.

title: Infiltrate
section: Set up after all warbands deployed, anywhere more than 12″ from enemies. Must be either not visible to enemies or wholly within area terrain.

title: Injured
section: Must make a morale check. If the only morale check trigger is being injured, they cannot panic unless the warband is broken

title: Jumping
section: Move at least 1″ down for every full 4″ horizontally.

title: Large (X)
section:
• Critical hit bonus of X for melee attacks
  • Reduce Heavy value by X
  • Shove roll bonus of X; models shoving this model incur a shove roll penalty of X
  • Add X to roll to determine falling damage
  • Not affected by difficult terrain

title: Malfunction
section:
Machines ignore the penalties for being seriously injured but malfunction instead. The effect is lost if no longer seriously injured. Malfunctions due to other causes last until the end of the round.

D4Malfunction
1Superficial Damage: No effect.
2Targeting Error: Hit roll penalty of 1 for all attacks. Multiple errors are cumulative.
3Weapon Jammed: Nominate one weapon you do not want jammed, then select a weapon at random (not One Use); this weapon can no longer be used.
If there are no possible weapons to select, treat as a Targeting Error instead.
4Immobilised: Mv is changed to 0″/0″. If already immobilised, treat as a Targeting Error instead.

title: Modifying Characteristics
section:
• BS/CS not better than 2+ or worse than 8+ Armour not better than 2+
  • Invulnerable and cover not better than 3+
  • A value not less than 1″

title: Moments of Glory
section:
Fatal Blow: Immediately destroy a model that is seriously injured, if successfully hit by your attack.
Refuse to Die: Destroyed at end of round instead of that phase. If used in the Resolution Phase, destroyed at start of next Resolution Phase. Can still be immediately destroyed. Last model in the warband can use this Moment even if faltering or panicking; they stop faltering or panicking and no longer make morale checks.
Swordbreaker: Discard a critical hit to reduce Dm of a weapon by Dm value of that hit, or to destroy a Shield (discarded hit must be Dm 2 or greater).
Last Hope: 1 victory point on 5+ at end of game.

title: Morale Checks
section: Only make one check - additional triggers add a Ld penalty. Models in reserve are still subject to making morale checks. Panic if roll for the check is less than half Ld.

title: Obscured
section: If less than half of a model is visible, cover save of 7+; or cover save of the terrain obscuring the model, if better. Models are not obscured by models in their unit or the attacker's unit.

title: Overheat
section: After attacking, X injuries on a roll of 1.

title: Panicking
section:
Cannot panic if only trigger is being injured.
  • Re-roll all successful hit rolls
  • Cannot aim
  • Non-scoring
  • Cannot be involved in a Moment of Glory
  • Cannot charge
  • Must retreat, moving directly away at least 10″ if possible. If the retreat moves within 1″ of enemies it is a charge, but they gain no charging bonuses and fight last. If they move off the battlefield edge, set up in reserve, or destroyed if the warband is broken.

title: Perils of the Warp
section:
D8Perils of the Warp
1-3Brainwyrm: Cannot manifest any powers, lose all warp charges.
Eldritch Horror: Also select one random power, cannot use it for rest of the game.
4-7Warp Surge: D3 injuries.
Eldritch Horror: 2D3 injuries instead.
8Eldritch Horror: Roll again and apply the second result. If a second 8 is rolled, the Psyker is immediately destroyed.

If Psyker is reduced to 0 life: D2 injuries within 3″, 1 injury within 6″, Psyker is immediately destroyed. Cannot suffer Perils more than once each round.

title: Plague
section: In Take Damage step, 1 injury on a roll of 2+.

title: Poison
section: In Take Damage step, 1 injury on a roll of 2+, then discard a Poison token.

title: Polearm
section: Fight first against targets that charged.

title: Psychic Powers
section: Two powers per round, no more than one warpfire. Blessings and hexes can be used before or after a model moves, or before hit rolls are made for an attack. If within 1″ of enemy models, can only affect models within 1″.

title: Promethium Barrels
section:
Critical hit bonus of 2 for Flame weapons while within 2″.
Can be hit by stray shots, Beam, Blast, Engulf or Sniper weapons, and hits that affect models in an area. For each hit, D8+Dm (automatic injuries have Dm 4): 9+, D2 injuries within 3″, 1 injury within 6″. Also, each model within 6″: on a 2+, get a Flame token, or 2 Flame tokens on an 8.

title: Quick Reflexes (X+)
section: Attacking models re-roll successful hit rolls of X+.

title: Rapid Fire
section: Use second A value if target is within half Rng.

title: Reserves
section:
D81-34-67-8
Round234
Arriving from reserve:
  • Place touching a battlefield edge and more than 1″ from any enemy models
  • Mv reduced by 5″ but treated as having moved full ordinary Mv
  • Non-scoring for the remainder of the round

title: Regeneration (X+)
section: X+: regain 1 life

title: Repair (X+)
section: Heal (see above), but may revert a malfunction instead of regaining life.

title: Retreating
section:
• Mv reduced by 5″
  • Cannot charge
  • Cannot make ranged attacks, unless acting during the first player turn
  • Non-scoring for the remainder of the round
  • Must move away from the models being retreated from, not around or past them
  • Cannot retreat if charged earlier that phase
  • Cannot be charged by the models they retreated from earlier that phase

title: Radiation
section: Roll a D8 first time the model loses life each phase; if value is equal to or less than number of Radiation tokens, suffer 1 injury.

title: Seriously Injured
section: Halve Mv (rounding up), hit roll penalty of 1 for all attacks. Must make a morale check (in addition to the morale check for being injured)

title: Shield
section: One block roll per phase - may discard a hit if block roll value is equal or greater.

title: Shove
section:
Instead of attacking, shove a model within 1″. On a 5+, shoved model moves 1″ directly away. Will fall if at least half their base is over an edge.
Modifiers:

  • Penalty of 1 if shoved model's armour is 4+ or better
  • Penalty of 1 if shoved model's CS is better
  • Bonus of 2 if shoving model charged

title: Sniper
section:
Hits cannot be re-allocated to other models. Can target specific models n a unit. Ignore stray shots.
Aiming: hit roll modifier is also a critical hit modifier.

title: Stealth (X)
section: Hit roll penalty of X for ranged attacks targeting this model. Multiple stealth abilities are cumulative.

title: Steed (X+)
section: Can attack with this weapon in addition to any other weapons; BS/CS is X+.

title: Stray Shots
section: Ranged hit rolls of 1; player controlling the target must re-allocate stray shots evenly to all models within 2″ or obscuring visibility to the target.

title: Stun
section: Hit roll penalty of 1, fight last. Discard all Stun tokens in the Recovery step.

title: Suppressive Fire
section:
Cannot aim. Successful hits do not inflict damage; critical hits use ordinary AP and Dm values.
Targets make a Ld check:

  • Bonus of 1 if only a single shot was fired at them (except with a Sniper weapon)
  • Penalty of 1 if weapon had A 2 or more, or Blast or Sniper type
  • Penalty of 1 if target has a cover, or penalty of 2 if cover is equal to or better than their armour or invulnerable save
  • Bonus of 2 if target is charging

If check is failed: target immediately takes cover. May finish their move if they were charging.

title: Sure-footed
section: Not affected by difficult terrain, only affected by dangerous terrain (of any type) on a roll of 1.

title: Taking Cover
section: Improve cover save by 1 until the end of the round. Cannot move any further that phase; treated as advancing. Fight last.

title: Terrain Depth
section: Improve cover by 1 for every full 3″ of area terrain.

title: Unit Coherency
section: Each model must be within 2″ horizontally and 5″ vertically of another model in the unit.

title: Wild Encounters
section:
After every player has had a turn in the Manoeuvring Phase, roll a D4: if less than or equal to round number, set up the wild model wholly within a random table quarter, more than 9″ from players, or more than 1″ from players if wholly within area terrain. Then scatter up to distance on scatter dice (final position must be more than 1″ from players).
Wild models are always last in the priority order.
